class.name: CgameXPBDCloth
class.brief_description: Native XPBD cloth simulation on a rectangular particle grid.
class.description: [CgameXPBDCloth] simulates a rectangular piece of cloth with extended position-based dynamics (XPBD). Stretch, shear and bending behaviour are modelled as distance constraints with a configurable compliance (inverse stiffness). The solver uses small sub-steps with one iteration each, optional sphere, capsule and plane colliders, a spatial-hash self-collision pass and constraint tearing. The cloth grid is created with [method setup_grid]. Particle [code](i, j)[/code] is placed at [code]origin * Vector3(i * spacing, -j * spacing, 0)[/code], so row 0 is the top edge, local [code]-Y[/code] runs down the cloth and local [code]+Z[/code] is the front-face normal. All positions handled by this class are in world space. Particles can be fixed in place with [method pin], follow a script callback with [method attach], or follow a position that is updated every frame with [method drive]. [ClothInstance3D] uses [method drive] to follow skeleton bones. [codeblock] var cloth := CgameXPBDCloth.new() cloth.setup_grid(20, 20, 0.05, Transform3D(Basis(), Vector3(0, 2, 0))) for i in range(cloth.columns()): cloth.pin(cloth.index_of(i, 0), cloth.positions()[cloth.index_of(i, 0)]) cloth.add_sphere(Vector3(0.5, 1.0, 0.2), 0.3) cloth.step(1.0 / 60.0, 8) [/codeblock] [b]Credits:[/b] Algorithm from Macklin, Müller and Chentanez, "XPBD: Position-Based Simulation of Compliant Constrained Dynamics" (2016). Structure follows Matthias Müller's "Ten Minute Physics" cloth demo (MIT License). This is a clean re-implementation from the published algorithm.

method.name: add_capsule
method.description: Adds a capsule collider between world-space points [param a] and [param b] and returns its index. Particles are kept outside [param radius] plus [member collision_margin].

method.name: add_plane
method.description: Adds a plane collider and returns its index. The half-space where [code]normal.dot(x) >= offset[/code] is free; particles are pushed out of the other side. [param normal] is normalized.

method.name: add_sphere
method.description: Adds a sphere collider in world space and returns its index. Particles are kept outside [param radius] plus [member collision_margin].

method.name: attach
method.description: Makes particle [param index] follow the [Vector3] returned by [param target_fn], which is called once per sub-step. The particle becomes immovable for the solver. Use [method unpin] to release it.

method.name: build_mesh
method.description: Builds an [ArrayMesh] with one triangle surface from the current world-space particle positions, normals, UVs and triangles. [param flags] are [enum Mesh.ArrayFormat] flags passed to [method ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays]. Returns an empty mesh when no triangles remain.

method.name: clear_colliders
method.description: Removes all sphere, capsule and plane colliders.

method.name: columns
method.description: Returns the number of particle columns ([code]width_cells + 1[/code]).

method.name: constraint_count
method.description: Returns the number of remaining constraints of all kinds. Tearing reduces this number.

method.name: drive
method.description: Sets the target position of an externally driven particle. The first call snaps the particle to [param world_pos]; later calls make it glide linearly toward the new target across the sub-steps of the next [method step]. This is cheaper than [method attach] because no callback is involved.

method.name: get_torn_count
method.description: Returns the total number of constraints removed by tearing since the last [method setup_grid].

method.name: index_of
method.description: Returns the particle index of column [param i] and row [param j].

method.name: is_pinned
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if particle [param index] is pinned, attached or driven.

method.name: max_stretch_error
method.description: Returns the largest [code]|length / rest - 1|[/code] over all stretch constraints, or [code]0[/code] when none remain.

method.name: normals
method.description: Returns smooth per-particle normals computed from the current triangles.

method.name: particle_count
method.description: Returns the number of particles.

method.name: pin
method.description: Fixes particle [param index] at [param world_pos]. Its inverse mass becomes zero and its position and velocity are reset.

method.name: positions
method.description: Returns the current world-space particle positions.

method.name: rows
method.description: Returns the number of particle rows ([code]height_cells + 1[/code]).

method.name: set_capsule
method.description: Moves the capsule collider [param index] to the segment from [param a] to [param b].

method.name: set_particle
method.description: Teleports particle [param index] to [param world_pos] and clears its velocity, for example to pre-fold the cloth.

method.name: set_sphere_center
method.description: Moves the sphere collider [param index] to [param center].

method.name: setup_grid
method.description: Builds a grid of [code]width_cells + 1[/code] by [code]height_cells + 1[/code] particles with [param spacing] meters between neighbours, placed relative to [param origin]. Stretch, shear and bending constraints and the render triangles are generated, and all previous state is discarded.

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the simulation by [param dt] seconds using [param substeps] sub-steps. Does nothing when [param dt] is not positive or the cloth has not been set up. Tearing is evaluated once after all sub-steps.

method.name: stretch_constraint_count
method.description: Returns the number of remaining stretch constraints.

method.name: triangles
method.description: Returns the triangle index list, three indices per triangle, counter-clockwise when seen from local [code]+Z[/code]. Triangles touching a torn edge are removed.

method.name: unpin
method.description: Releases particle [param index] and restores its original mass.

method.name: uvs
method.description: Returns per-particle UV coordinates covering the grid from [code](0, 0)[/code] to [code](1, 1)[/code].

method.name: velocities
method.description: Returns the current particle velocities.

members.member: Particle radius used for collider contact, in meters.
Compliance (inverse stiffness, m/N) of the bending constraints. Larger values give softer cloth.
Compliance of the stretch constraints. [code]0[/code] makes them fully rigid.
Air drag rate in 1/s toward the [member wind] velocity. With zero wind this is plain damping.
Tangential damping applied on collider contact, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code].
Solver iterations per sub-step. Values below [code]1[/code] are clamped to [code]1[/code].
If [code]true[/code], particles that were not neighbours at rest are kept at least [member thickness] apart using a spatial hash.
Stretch constraints longer than [code]rest * tear_threshold[/code] are removed together with the dependent shear, bending and triangle data. [code]0[/code] disables tearing.
Minimum distance kept between non-neighbouring particles when [member self_collision_enabled] is [code]true[/code]. Also the spatial hash cell size.
Wind velocity the air drags particles toward.

constants.constant: Constraint family keeping grid neighbours at their rest distance.
Constraint family keeping the cell diagonals at their rest distance.
Constraint family connecting every second particle to resist folding.
